audience: small sales teams that manage contacts and opportunities in CentrixOne

useCases.title: Find contacts in a list
useCases.text: List contacts with their list memberships, filtered by a contact, an external id or a list.

useCases.title: Review opportunities and their owners
useCases.text: List the sales opportunities with their stage and value. List the users who own them.

useCases.title: Read the revenue types
useCases.text: List the revenue types of the account at one of three levels.

useCases.title: Add a contact or edit one
useCases.text: Create a contact, or edit one by its contact id or external id, and add it to a list. Fields you omit keep their value.
